scope: class '2'; single-stroke topology; HWRT train fit and UJI train query; path_mode=cross-class

method.shape_space: median-centered low-rank PCA over aligned 128-point XY trajectories
method.neighbor_correlation: convex interpolation between a real UJI class-2 query and a direction-compatible real HWRT sample from the query's frozen-teacher strongest rival class; no independent point noise
method.radius: 68th percentile of pairwise distances among low-rank standardized HWRT training shapes; this is a data-derived distance limit, not a Gaussian +/-1 SD region
method.sampling: sweep 25/50/75/100% of the capped query-to-donor interpolation path; intermediate points are synthetic and human plausibility is not established by convexity alone
method.time_transform: none; observed and ordinal timing channels are preserved byte-identically
method.boundary: target logit minus maximum logit of all competing classes <= 0

geometry_gates.xy_bounds: convex combinations of valid real inputs; no clipping

provenance.query_source: UJI Pen v2 official writer-disjoint train split only

teacher_margin_boundary.definition: first tested interpolation fraction where logit(2) minus strongest rival logit is non-positive, among baseline-top1-correct rows with a complete valid path
teacher_margin_boundary.interpretation: cross-label real-to-real path; crossing estimates only the frozen teacher's boundary, not a human decision threshold or valid soft label

adaptive_teacher_boundary_refinement.boundary_definition: frozen teacher logit(2)-max(logits of all other classes) crossing along the q68-capped interpolation path

numeric_candidate_cache.use: reproducible frozen-teacher pseudo-target experiments; no assigned hard synthetic labels

human_review_queue.purpose: teacher-labelled diagnostic sheet; use the separate blind queue for human boundary measurement

adaptive_teacher_boundary_refinement.probability_note: T=2 softmax summaries are frozen-teacher pseudo-target diagnostics, not calibrated human confidence.

interpretation_boundary: training-pool diagnostic only; no independent performance estimate, no student training, no model selection, and no product promotion
